visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with waist-length straight brown hair stands by a grey brick balustrade, initially showing her back to the camera. As she turns slightly to the left, her profile and a portion of her black sleeveless dress with a chest cutout are revealed. The background features lush green hills, a traditional Chinese wooden structure with a tiled roof, and a clear blue sky with soft white clouds. (2) The scene transitions to a full-body tracking shot of the woman walking confidently down a narrow cobblestone street. She carries a white quilted handbag with a gold chain strap. The pathway is flanked by ancient-style grey brick buildings, some of which are covered in dense green ivy. Overhead, strings of light bulbs and black power lines crisscross against the bright, sunny sky. (3) The camera captures a medium close-up of the woman as she turns around quickly, her long hair billowing slightly in the air. She wears small gold earrings and looks directly into the lens with a soft, confident smile. The background remains the ivy-covered brick wall and the sunny alleyway, providing a warm and inviting atmosphere. (4) In the final phase, the woman walks towards the camera in a crowded area with stone steps and many tourists in the background. She maintains eye contact, smiling broadly, and eventually brings her right hand to her lips to blow a playful kiss toward the viewer. Her white branded bag is prominently displayed on her shoulder as she moves.
